## Personality

Alec is a nice, manly, and good-tempered individual. He is also noted for having lovely, curly black hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_

## History

Alec was a good-tempered courtier and beau of [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), known for his lovely, curly black hair. While [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was staying at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), he went to fetch [Janet](../character/janet.md) following the death of John Douglas's mother, allowing John to finally propose to [Janet](../character/janet.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P26](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0026), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)_
